## Context
Before merged Change 1847, at the parent of commit 034e17209c, tests/scripts/test_autodeploy_review_drain.py constructed `env = dict(os.environ)` and returned that mapping inside the `box` fixture value. A deliberate nested-pytest RED probe against that pre-fix revision placed a synthetic sentinel before PATH and observed pytest default-long traceback rendering print it; no real credential value was used or recorded. Commit 034e17209c repaired that defect: the current file at lines 149-165 now constructs a narrow PATH-plus-harness allowlist. This ticket records and verifies the already-landed repair; it does not claim the current fixture still copies the full environment. The performance ticket must not absorb this unrelated security fix.

## Plan
- Reproduce on the pre-fix revision with a synthetic first-position sentinel in the ambient environment and a deliberate assertion failure.
- Change the fixture boundary to pass only required environment variables while preserving the real bash subprocess environment needed by the tests.
- Audit sibling subprocess fixtures for the same `dict(os.environ)`-inside-rendered-fixture shape.
- Prove on the repaired revision that the synthetic sentinel never appears in pytest default-long failure output while the autodeploy suite remains behaviorally green.

## Scope and alternative rationale
The construct sweep separates two runtime carriers rather than deferring equivalent leaks. This parent and child dumbstruck-wonderful-xiphosuran own the eight decorated fixtures whose returned values pytest renders as function arguments; explicit allowlists are correct there because minimal-parent runs prove their consumers need only declared harness values. The remaining broad mappings are test-local or helper values exposed only when subprocess startup itself raises. Some intentionally forward the invoking pytest environment or environment-only live-service credentials, so applying the fixture allowlist would break their contract. Follow-up antiutopic-toadyish-goldfinch owns all 103 of those sites as one atomic shared representation-safe mapping migration, with a repository guard and exact child-value preservation test. A repo-wide allowlist was rejected because it would drop required values; independent per-file wrappers were rejected because they would duplicate the same diagnostic boundary without enforcement. Pytest `--tb=short` was a useful negative control but was rejected as remediation because it globally reduces debugging detail and only masks this traceback carrier; the repaired fixture boundary remains safe under the default long traceback. ADR 0041 governs durable LLM diagnostic fields rather than pytest fixture representations; its fail-closed allowlist posture is nevertheless followed for these decorated fixtures.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] [operator-attested] A deterministic regression test fails on the pre-fix revision because a synthetic ambient secret appears in captured pytest failure rendering.
  provenance: environment=sanitized-red-probe-034e17209c; principal=RebarBotNava; privilege_posture=narrower; instrument=simulation — real nested pytest default-long traceback with first-position synthetic sentinel
- [x] The synthetic secret is absent from failure output after the fix.
- [x] Required PATH and autodeploy environment behavior remains covered through the real bash subprocess.
- [x] Sibling occurrences are inventoried and either fixed or linked as follow-ups.
- [x] [operator-attested] Repository gates and Gerrit votes pass before closure.
  provenance: environment=gerrit-ci-run-32101886011; principal=rebar-ci-bot; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=static-analysis — canonical Gerrit Verified and LLM-Review gates for merged change 1847
